description: Arizona employer payroll for 2026, state income tax withholding and state unemployment insurance. Withholding is a percentage of each employee's gross taxable wages (federal W-2 box 1 wages) chosen on Form A-4 (0.5%, 1.0%, 1.5%, 2.0%, 2.5%, 3.0% or 3.5%, or zero), with 2.0% withheld when no A-4 is given within five days of hire; nonresidents are withheld after 60 days in Arizona. Payments follow the federal deposit schedule once quarterly withholding averaged over $1,500, otherwise quarterly with Form A1-QRT (due 30 April, 31 July, 31 October, 31 January); the annual Form A1-R and W-2s are due 31 January. Unemployment insurance (Arizona DES) for 2026 is on the first $8,000 of each employee's wages, at 2.00% for new employers and 0.03% to 8.36% for rated employers. Also covers earned paid sick time accrual and final pay timing.
